label: Dubstep / Future Garage (UK Garage-Derived, 2-Step)
tempo_line: Tempo as written 130-136 BPM, felt as written (no half-time)
tempo_note: Tempo is written the sourced dubstep way: 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 (drumstep: about 172-174, felt 86-87). The official melodic dubstep cards say 171 for the same kind of music. Compare by ear before trusting either.
note: Studio-authored recipe, not an official Music 3 template, untested (nothing has been rendered from it yet).

cards.mood: Moody and nocturnal: crackle and a pitched vocal chop open the track, a skipping 2-step beat and a warm bass enter, the chops form a hazy hook, a stripped midsection leaves pads and rain, and a fuller return fades into the crackle.
cards.vocal: No lead singer. Chopped, pitched vocal hits are played like a synth, forming short melodic stabs between the bass phrases.
cards.palette: A warm, filtered, detuned bass and a clean sub follow slow minor chords with long notes, while re-pitched vocal chops play the main hook.
cards.tempo_line: written 130 BPM, felt as written (no half-time)

cards.mood: Intimate and aching: a fragmented, pitched vocal floats over pads, the beat enters, the phrases pile up into a hazy hook with the bass swelling beneath, and a gentle bridge strips back to voice and rain before a final, fuller hook.
cards.vocal: Singer A (Female). The vocalist possesses a soft, hushed, slightly husky timbre, heard mostly as pitched and shifted fragments.
cards.palette: A soft, filtered bass and a sub follow the chords under the pitched vocal phrases, with a round-attack lead doubling the melody in the hook.
cards.tempo_line: written 134 BPM, felt as written (no half-time)
